_note: EN is the first translation target. Keys mirror ru.json exactly. A missing key here falls back to the RU string (i18n.config fallbackLocale), so a partial translation still renders a coherent console. This file is the worked example of 'translate a screen' — the developer extends it screen by screen as pages are keyed.
